notes: Interactive HTML reports with photo thumbnail previews, damaged-photo detection, and customizable naming
changelog: Added: generate thumbnails for recovered photos, either standalone (a folder of images ready to zip and send) or embedded directly into the interactive HTML report — clients see actual photo previews with hover and full-size lightbox navigation, without needing the full original files

Added: thumbnail coverage can be limited to a percentage of photos per folder (to keep the report/package small) — the report clearly states the coverage percentage to the client, and the label updates correctly when switching the report's language

Added: detects photos that fail to decode or look visually damaged (solid-color blocks, black frames, partial corruption) during thumbnail generation, and flags them for review in the report — including cases the original signature/structure scan didn't catch

Added: when a base output folder is configured, reports with thumbnails are written directly there (auto-named by case) instead of round-tripping through the source drive — important when the source is a fragile/space-limited recovery drive

Added: a custom {C} token for filenames, case names, and report titles (e.g. a company name), alongside the existing {F}/{D}/{T}/{N}/{B}/{L} tokens — case name now supports the full token set and remembers your template between sessions
Added: live previews for the computed filename, case name, and destination folder name, so it's clear what will actually be generated before you click
Fixed: folder-picker dialogs sometimes showed the wrong description (e.g. the scan-folder picker showed the report-save-folder text) and never translated into the selected app language
Fixed: generating a report with thumbnails from the Scanner tab could leave a duplicate copy of the thumbnail folder behind on the source drive after the report was saved
